claim.claim-text: 1. An X-ray apparatus (1), comprising:

a target (13) which is configured to generate an X-ray by irradiation of electrons to the target, the X-ray apparatus being of reflective or transmissive type; a filament (17) configured to release the electrons to the target; and a housing (15) that has the filament therein, characterised by:

a first holding member (16) disposed outside the housing and configured to hold the target on the outside of the housing; and a second holding member (20) configured to hold the housing a portion of the housing is movable with respect to the the target and the second holding member in an axial direction of the housing, being a direction substantially parallel to a path of the electrons from the filament to the target.

2. The X-ray apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the target has a first end portion and a second end portion, and the first holding member is configured to hold the first and second end portions of the target.
3. The X-ray apparatus according to claim 2, wherein the target has a rod shape.

4. The X-ray apparatus according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the second holding member is configured to hold the housing at a first portion of the housing and a second portion of the housing, and the second portion of the housing is movable with respect to the first portion of the housing.
5. The X-ray apparatus according to claim 4, further comprising a third holding member (22) that joins to the second holding member and is configured to support the housing at the first portion.
6. The X-ray apparatus according to any preceding claim, wherein the first holding member and the second holding member are fixed with each other.
7. The X-ray apparatus according to any preceding claim, further comprising a support member (8) configured to support the first holding member and the second holding member.
8. The X-ray apparatus according to claim 5, further comprising:

a stage apparatus (3) configured to hold an object to which the X-ray from the target is irradiated; and a detection device (4) configured to detect at least a portion of the X-ray passed through the object, wherein: a) the support member is configured to support the stage apparatus and the detection device or b) there is provided a first driving device (33) configured to move the support member and a second driving device configured to move the detection device in synchronization with the movement of the support member.
9. The X-ray apparatus according to claim 8, wherein, in operation, in at least a portion of a period when the X-ray is irradiated to the object, the stage apparatus rotates the object.
10. The X-ray apparatus (100) according to any preceding claim wherein the second holding member (20) extends parallel to the axial direction of the housing.

11. The X-ray apparatus according to claim 8, wherein the first holding member (16) is orthogonal to the axial direction of the housing; and wherein the first holding member and the housing make contact.
12. The X-ray apparatus according to claim 11, wherein a longitudinal direction of the target intersects with a direction in which the electrons emitted from the filament travel.

13. The X-ray apparatus according to claim 2 or 3, wherein the first holding member includes a first-end-portion holding member (16A) which is configured to hold the first end portion and a second-end-portion holding member (16B) which is configured to hold the second end portion.
14. A method for manufacturing a structure, the method comprising:

15. The method for manufacturing the structure according to claim 14, further comprising a repairing step executed based on a comparison result of the inspecting step, for implementing reworking of the structure.
16. The method for manufacturing the structure according to claim 15, wherein the repairing step is a step for re-executing the molding step.
17. The method for manufacturing the structure according to any one of claims 14 to 16, wherein the measuring step includes measuring dimensions of an outer shape of the structure.
